For smokers, the probability of high tar deposit is 64%. For nonsmokers and with no tar deposit, the probability of being allergic to peanuts is 46%. For smokers and with high tar deposit, the probability of being allergic to peanuts is 43%. The overall probability of smoking is 49%. Will smoking decrease the chance of being allergic to peanuts?
